cards.title: Ikea Shop Reveals Parenting Wisdom Gaps
cards.body: A visit to Ikea becomes a reality check about what domestic skills parents have actually taught their children. The pre-university shopping trip exposes surprising gaps in everyday knowledge.

cards.title: Kids' Quiz: Test Knowledge With Junior Brainteasers
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions set by children test your knowledge on fun topics like octopus blood color and sky weight. Submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: Finding Wonder in Suburban Family Life
cards.body: A family's suburban move initially felt boring until they discovered excitement in unexpected places. The shift in perspective changed how they experienced their new neighborhood.

cards.title: Ordinary Moments With Children Matter Most
cards.body: The everyday moments you assume will happen again are often the ones you miss most after they're gone. Learning to notice these ordinary times now helps us appreciate them fully.

cards.title: Managing Neurodivergent Kids Without Over-Accommodating
cards.body: Parents of neurodivergent children often confuse diagnosis with capability, leading to over-accommodation. The key question isn't what they're diagnosed with, but what they can handle right now.

cards.title: Parent Guilt Requires Balance, Not Blame
cards.body: Parents need neither excessive guilt nor absolution from responsibility. A family systems approach offers a pathway from blame to agency and hope.

cards.title: Supporting Adult Parents Through Their Divorce
cards.body: When your parents divorce as an adult, your role in the family can shift significantly. Support them without becoming their therapist, mediator, or emotional safety net.

cards.title: Art and Music Build Childhood Resilience
cards.body: Engaging with drama, art, and music unlocks joy and expands cognitive horizons in children. These activities build lifelong resilience and emotional development.
